{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Match and Keep
| Image = Event-MatchAndKeep.png
}}
{{E|Match and Keep}} is a shrine [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Play}} 
* Play a matching game for cards. Match pairs of cards to add them to your deck. There is always a pair of one {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless}} card and one {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
A gremlin is madly shuffling cards on a table. This monster seems to be a harmless one. You approach him out of curiosity.
</div>

Before selecting {{Frame|Play}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"{{TS|blue||Twelve}} cards! Match them to keep them! {{TS|blue||Five}} tries, no do-overs. <br>
Are you ready? Let's start!"
</div></blockquote>

After {{Frame|Play}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You complete the gremlin's game and look up. <br>
He disappeared?
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
